description: This file defines API endpoints related to managing user favorites within a FastAPI application. It includes functions for listing, adding, and removing favorite recipes, as well as converting database models to response schemas.

methods.name: FavoriteResponse _favorite_to_response(fav: Favorite)
methods.description: Converts a Favorite database model instance to a FavoriteResponse schema object, ensuring timezone-aware 'created_at'.

methods.name: RecipeResponse _recipe_to_response(recipe: Recipe)
methods.description: Converts a Recipe database model instance to a RecipeResponse schema object, including loading tags and ensuring timezone-aware timestamps.

methods.name: list[FavoriteResponse] list_favorites(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends())
methods.description: Lists all favorite entries for the current user, returning them as a list of FavoriteResponse objects.

methods.name: list[RecipeResponse] list_favorite_recipes( user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(), )
methods.description: Retrieves and returns full recipe objects that the current user has favorited.

methods.name: FavoriteResponse add_favorite( recipe_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(), )
methods.description: Adds a recipe to the current user's favorites, or returns existing if already favorited.

methods.name: None remove_favorite( recipe_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(), )
methods.description: Removes a recipe from the current user's favorites.

ctags.name: add_favorite
ctags.signature: ( recipe_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(), )

ctags.name: list_favorite_recipes
ctags.signature: ( user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(), )

ctags.name: list_favorites
ctags.pattern: /^async def list_favorites(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends()) -/

ctags.name: remove_favorite
ctags.signature: ( recipe_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(), )
